# Parameters

<!-- Generated by tools/docs/generate.ts from the code registries. Do not edit; run `pnpm docs:gen`. -->

Every GET query parameter of `/v1/map` and `/v1/map.{png,jpg,webp}`. The POST body (a JSON MapSpec) has the same options as nested fields, shown in the "JSON field" column (`routes[]` means each element of `routes`; GET fills the first). The full body schema is `components.schemas.MapSpec` in `/openapi.json` on the server.

## Area and framing

What the map is about and how it is framed. All of these are optional, but a map needs an `area`, `bounds`, a route or at least one point.

| Parameter | JSON field | Value | Default | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `area` | `area` | string \| object | — | The area to frame and highlight. Ambiguous names return 409 with candidates. Name, `iso:CZ`, `iso:CZ-72`, `osm:r51684` or `wikidata:Q213`. | `area=Czechia` |
| `level` | `area.level` | integer, 1–11 | — | Only match areas at this OSM admin level (2 = country; regions and municipalities vary by country). Narrows a name lookup (turns `area` into `{query, level}`). | `level=8` |
| `country` | `area.country` | string | — | Only match areas inside this ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country. Narrows a name lookup. | `country=CZ` |
| `bounds` | `bounds` | string | — | Explicit frame `[west, south, east, north]`; overrides automatic framing. `west,south,east,north`. | `bounds=12.09,48.55,18.86,51.06` |
| `padding` | `padding` | number, 0–0.45 | `0.04` | Space around the framed content as a fraction of the image size. | `padding=0.04` |
| `projection` | `projection` | `mercator` \| `globe` \| `auto` | `mercator` | Map projection. `mercator` is the usual flat web map. `globe` draws an orthographic globe, which keeps continent-spanning routes and high latitudes true to shape; the content must fit on one hemisphere (within 85° of the view center), and neighbor labels are not available. `auto` picks the globe when the content spans more than 50° or Mercator would stretch it more than 2.5× between its lowest and highest latitude, else Mercator. `mercator` (default), `globe` or `auto`. | `projection=globe` |
| `globeview` | `globe.view` | `full` \| `fit` | `full` | How much of the globe to show. `full` (default): the whole globe, centered on your content, with space around it; recognizable at a glance as a globe. `fit`: zoomed in until the content fills the image; a larger scale with more detail along the route, but only part of the globe is visible. `full` (default) or `fit`. | `globeview=fit` |

## Points

Labeled markers. Repeat `poi` for each point; options go after the location, separated by `|`.

| Parameter | JSON field | Value | Default | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `poi` | `pois` | string (repeatable) | — | Points with markers and labels (up to 50). `lat,lon` or `place:Name`, followed by `\|option:value` pairs (see POI options). Repeat for more points. | `poi=49.13,17.33\|label:Chřiby\|marker:triangle` |

## Route

One route per GET request (use POST for several). Give `from` and `to`, or a `polyline`.

| Parameter | JSON field | Value | Default | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `from` | `routes[].from` | string | — | Start point when the server should compute the line. `lat,lon` or `place:Name`. A route needs `from`+`to` or `polyline`. | `from=40.4168,-3.7038` |
| `to` | `routes[].to` | string | — | Finish point when the server should compute the line. | `to=place:Sevilla` |
| `via` | `routes[].via` | string (repeatable) | — | Points the route must pass through, in order. | `via=38.98,-3.93` |
| `profile` | `routes[].profile` | `car` \| `bike` \| `foot` \| `straight` \| `geodesic` | `geodesic` | How endpoints are connected: routed by `car`/`bike`/`foot` (needs a routing engine on the server or your `X-Routing-Key`), or locally as `straight` segments or `geodesic` great-circle arcs. The default `geodesic` always works (no routing engine, key or plan feature needed) and is the true shortest path, so it suits flights and locator maps; ask for `car`/`bike`/`foot` explicitly for roads. | `profile=straight` |
| `polyline` | `routes[].polyline` | string | — | The line as an encoded polyline (Google algorithm). URL-encode it (polylines can contain `\|`, `?` and `\`). | ``polyline=_p~iF~ps\|U_ulLnnqC_mqNvxq`@`` |
| `polylineprecision` | `routes[].polylinePrecision` | `5` \| `6` | `5` | Polyline precision: 5 (Google) or 6 (Valhalla/OSRM). | `polylineprecision=6` |
| `routeprovider` | `routes[].provider` | `valhalla` \| `openrouteservice` \| `graphhopper` | — | Routing provider (default: the server's). openrouteservice and GraphHopper need a key (server-side or `X-Routing-Key`). | `routeprovider=valhalla` |
| `routecolor` | `routes[].color` | string | `#d01c1c` | Color of the route line. | `routecolor=#d01c1c` |
| `routewidth` | `routes[].width` | number, 0.5–20 | `3` | Line width in px. | `routewidth=3` |
| `routecasing` | `routes[].casingColor` | string | `#ffffff` | Outline drawn under the line so it reads on busy basemaps. | `routecasing=#ffffff` |
| `routedash` | `routes[].dash` | string | — | Dash pattern in line widths, e.g. `[2, 1.5]`. Comma-separated. | `routedash=2,1.5` |
| `routeopacity` | `routes[].opacity` | number, 0–1 | `1` | Line opacity. | `routeopacity=0.9` |
| `fromlabel` | `routes[].start.label` | string | — | Label at this end (default: the place name, if the end was given as a place). | `fromlabel=Madrid` |
| `tolabel` | `routes[].finish.label` | string | — | Label at this end (default: the place name, if the end was given as a place). | `tolabel=Sevilla` |
| `frommarker` | `routes[].start.marker.shape` | `pin` \| `dot` \| `ring` \| `flag` \| `triangle` \| `circle` \| `square` \| `star` \| `diamond` | — | Marker preset. Defaults depend on the role: plain point → `pin`, route start → `ring`, route finish → `flag`. | `frommarker=dot` |
| `tomarker` | `routes[].finish.marker.shape` | `pin` \| `dot` \| `ring` \| `flag` \| `triangle` \| `circle` \| `square` \| `star` \| `diamond` | — | Marker preset. Defaults depend on the role: plain point → `pin`, route start → `ring`, route finish → `flag`. | `tomarker=pin` |
| `showfrom` | `routes[].start.show` | boolean | `true` | `false` hides the marker and label for this end. | `showfrom=false` |
| `showto` | `routes[].finish.show` | boolean | `true` | `false` hides the marker and label for this end. | `showto=false` |

## Image

Size, format and attribution of the output image.

| Parameter | JSON field | Value | Default | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `w` (alias `width`) | `width` | integer, 64–2048 | `600` | Image width in CSS px (the output is width × `scale` pixels). | `w=468` |
| `h` (alias `height`) | `height` | integer, 64–2048 | `400` | Image height in CSS px, including the title band if any. | `h=280` |
| `scale` | `scale` | integer, 1–3 | `1` | Pixel ratio for high-DPI output (2 = retina). | `scale=2` |
| `format` | `format` | `png` \| `jpeg` \| `webp` | `png` | Image format (GET can also use the path extension: /v1/map.png, .jpg, .webp). Or use the path extension: `/v1/map.webp`. | `format=webp` |
| `quality` | `quality` | integer, 1–100 | `90` | JPEG/WebP quality. | `quality=85` |
| `attribution` | `attribution` | `bottom-right` \| `bottom-left` \| `top-right` \| `top-left` | `bottom-right` | Corner for the data attribution (always drawn; required by the data licenses). | `attribution=bottom-left` |

## Basemap

The map underneath: a built-in preset or your own MapLibre style.

| Parameter | JSON field | Value | Default | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `preset` | `basemap.preset` | `locator-relief` \| `light` \| `dark` | `locator-relief` | Built-in basemap: shaded relief (Wikipedia locator style), light, or dark. No key needed. | `preset=dark` |
| `style` | `basemap.styleUrl` | string | — | Any MapLibre style.json URL; overrides `preset`. `{key}` in the URL is replaced with `providerKey`. URL-encode it. | `style=https://api.maptiler.com/maps/streets-v2/style.json?key={key}` |
| `key` | `basemap.providerKey` | string | — | Key for a commercial style (prefer the `X-Provider-Key` header so it stays out of URLs). Prefer the `X-Provider-Key` header so the key stays out of URLs and logs. | `key=your-provider-key` |

## Highlight

How the area stands out. Unset values use the defaults of the chosen basemap preset.

| Parameter | JSON field | Value | Default | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `fade` | `highlight.fade` | number, 0–1 | `0.45` (varies by preset) | How much the surroundings are washed out: 0 = not at all, 1 = fully covered. | `fade=0.6` |
| `fadecolor` | `highlight.fadeColor` | string | `#ffffff` (varies by preset) | Color the surroundings fade towards. URL-encode `#` as `%23`. | `fadecolor=#ffffff` |
| `outline` | `highlight.outlineColor` | string | `#555555` (varies by preset) | Area outline color. | `outline=#555555` |
| `outlinewidth` | `highlight.outlineWidth` | number, 0–10 | `1.1` (varies by preset) | Area outline width in px; 0 = none. | `outlinewidth=2` |
| `tint` | `highlight.tint` | string | — | Optional color tint drawn over the area. | `tint=#d03030` |
| `tintopacity` | `highlight.tintOpacity` | number, 0–1 | `0.15` (varies by preset) | Opacity of `tint`. | `tintopacity=0.12` |
| `subdivisions` | `highlight.subdivisions` | boolean \| string \| integer, `auto`, 3–11 | `auto` (varies by preset) | Inner admin borders: `auto` draws the next level that splits the area, a number forces that admin level, `false` hides them. `auto`, `false`, or an admin level number. | `subdivisions=auto` |
| `desaturate` | `highlight.desaturate` | number, 0–1 | `0` (varies by preset) | Outside the area: 0 = full color, 1 = grayscale (applied on top of `fade`). | `desaturate=0.8` |
| `blur` | `highlight.blur` | number, 0–20 | `0` (varies by preset) | Outside the area: blur radius in CSS px; 0 = sharp. | `blur=1.5` |
| `subarea` | `highlight.subArea` | string \| object | — | A second, smaller area highlighted inside the framed one (e.g. a region within its country). | `subarea=Zlínský kraj` |
| `subareacolor` | `highlight.subAreaColor` | string | `#d03030` (varies by preset) | Fill and outline color of `subArea`. | `subareacolor=#c0392b` |
| `subareaopacity` | `highlight.subAreaOpacity` | number, 0–1 | `0.35` (varies by preset) | Fill opacity of `subArea`. | `subareaopacity=0.35` |
| `subareaoutlinewidth` | `highlight.subAreaOutlineWidth` | number, 0–10 | `1.2` (varies by preset) | Outline width of `subArea` in px; 0 = none. | `subareaoutlinewidth=1.2` |
| `worldview` | `worldview` | `ar` \| `bd` \| `br` \| `cn` \| `de` \| `eg` \| `es` \| `fr` \| `gb` \| `gr` \| `id` \| `il` \| `in` \| `it` \| `jp` \| `kr` \| `ma` \| `nl` \| `np` \| `pk` \| `pl` \| `ps` \| `pt` \| `ru` \| `sa` \| `se` \| `tr` \| `tw` \| `ua` \| `us` \| `vn` | — | Draw country borders as this country sees them (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. `in`, `cn`, `us`, `ma`). Replaces the basemap's country and disputed borders with Natural Earth's borders for that worldview, and uses its country shapes for a highlighted country and for neighbor labels. Regions, cities and everything below country level stay OpenStreetMap. Default: the basemap's borders (OpenStreetMap, on-the-ground control). One of the 31 Natural Earth worldviews; the Locator maps guide explains what changes ("Disputed borders"). | `worldview=in` |

## Neighboring countries

Labels for the countries around the area. Requires `neighbors`; the other options refine it.

| Parameter | JSON field | Value | Default | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `neighbors` | `neighbors.show` | `name` \| `code` \| `flag` \| `flag+code` \| `flag+name` | `name` | What to show for each neighboring country: its name, its international vehicle registration code (D, A, SK…), its flag, or a flag with code/name. `false`/`none` turns them off. A literal `+` may arrive as a space; both work. | `neighbors=flag+code` |
| `neighborfit` | `neighbors.fit` | `extend` \| `shrink` \| `drop` | `extend` | When a label does not fit in the visible part of its country: `extend` grows the image on that side (the output becomes larger than width×height; see `X-Image-Width`), `shrink` reduces the label to 70 %, `drop` omits it. | `neighborfit=extend` |
| `neighborwhich` | `neighbors.which` | `touching` \| `visible` | `touching` | `touching` = countries bordering the area; `visible` = every other country in the frame. | `neighborwhich=visible` |
| `neighborsize` | `neighbors.size` | number, 6–32 | `12` | Text size in CSS px; flags are sized to match. | `neighborsize=12` |
| `neighborcolor` | `neighbors.color` | string | — | Text color (default: the theme's muted label color). | `neighborcolor=#666666` |
| `neighborupper` | `neighbors.uppercase` | boolean | `false` | Uppercase country names. | `neighborupper=true` |

## Labels and typography

Language and font of everything drawn on top of the basemap.

| Parameter | JSON field | Value | Default | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `lang` | `lang` | string | — | Label language (ISO 639-1). Default: local names (Deutschland, Polska), as on Wikipedia locator maps. | `lang=en` |
| `font` | `font.family` | `noto-sans` \| `noto-serif` \| `noto-sans-mono` | `noto-sans` | A bundled family, or your own TTF/OTF/WOFF as a `data:` URI or an https URL on an allowed host (`MINIMAPS_FONT_HOSTS`). Missing glyphs fall back to Noto Sans, then Noto Sans Mono. Bundled families only in GET; custom fonts via POST. | `font=noto-serif` |
| `fontweight` | `font.weight` | integer, 100–900 | `400` | Weight for all labels (100–900; the nearest bundled weight is used). | `fontweight=600` |

## Title band

An optional title band inside the requested width and height. Requires `title`; the other options refine it.

| Parameter | JSON field | Value | Default | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | `title.text` | string | — | Title text (one line; long titles shrink, then get an ellipsis). | `title=Madrid – Seville` |
| `titlepos` | `title.position` | `top` \| `bottom` | `top` | Band above or below the map. | `titlepos=bottom` |
| `titlealign` | `title.align` | `left` \| `center` \| `right` | `left` | Text alignment in the band. | `titlealign=center` |
| `titlesize` | `title.size` | number, 8–64 | `18` | Text size in CSS px. | `titlesize=20` |
| `titleweight` | `title.weight` | integer, 100–900 | `600` | Font weight. | `titleweight=700` |
| `titlecolor` | `title.color` | string | — | Text color (default: the theme label color). | `titlecolor=#1a1a1a` |
| `titlebg` | `title.background` | string | — | Band background (default: white, or near-black on the dark preset). | `titlebg=#ffffff` |

## POI options (inside `poi=`)

A `poi` value is a location followed by `|key:value` options: `lat,lon|label:Chřiby|marker:triangle`. The location is `lat,lon` or `place:Name`.

| Option | JSON field | Value | Default | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | `pois[].label` | string | — | Label text. A newline (`\n` in GET) starts a new line. `\n` (backslash-n) starts a new line. `\|` cannot appear in a label in GET; use POST. | `label:Chřiby` |
| `pos` | `pois[].labelPosition` | `auto` \| `right` \| `left` \| `top` \| `bottom` \| `top-right` \| `top-left` \| `bottom-right` \| `bottom-left` | `auto` | Where the label goes relative to the marker. `auto` picks the first free spot and falls back to a leader line. | `pos:bottom` |
| `labelsize` | `pois[].labelSize` | number, 6–48 | `16` | Label text size in CSS px. | `labelsize:16` |
| `weight` | `pois[].labelWeight` | integer, 100–900 | — | Font weight for this label (overrides `font.weight`). | `weight:700` |
| `labelcolor` | `pois[].labelColor` | string | — | Label color (default: the basemap theme's label color). | `labelcolor:#1a1a1a` |
| `leader` | `pois[].leader` | boolean | `true` | When no free spot is next to the marker, place the label further out with a thin leader line. | `leader:false` |
| `marker` | `pois[].marker.shape` | `pin` \| `dot` \| `ring` \| `flag` \| `triangle` \| `circle` \| `square` \| `star` \| `diamond` | — | Marker preset. Defaults depend on the role: plain point → `pin`, route start → `ring`, route finish → `flag`. | `marker:triangle` |
| `color` | `pois[].marker.color` | string | — | Marker fill color. | `color:#e02020` |
| `size` | `pois[].marker.size` | number, 4–64 | — | Marker height in CSS pixels (multiplied by `scale`). Default depends on the shape. | `size:14` |
| `stroke` | `pois[].marker.strokeColor` | string | — | Outline color (default white where the shape has an outline). | `stroke:#ffffff` |
| `strokewidth` | `pois[].marker.strokeWidth` | number, 0–8 | — | Outline width in px; 0 = none. `dot` and `pin` have a thin default outline. | `strokewidth:1.5` |
| `icon` | `pois[].marker.icon` | string | — | Custom icon instead of the shape: an SVG/PNG `data:` URI, or an https URL on a host the server allows (`MINIMAPS_ICON_HOSTS`). SVGs with external references or scripts are rejected. URL-encode the value (base64 contains `+`, `/` and `=`). | `icon:data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2Zy8+` |
| `anchor` | `pois[].marker.anchor` | `center` \| `bottom` | — | Which point of a custom icon sits on the location: its center, or its bottom edge (pin-shaped icons). | `anchor:bottom` |

## POST-only

These cannot be expressed as query parameters; send a JSON body to `POST /v1/map`.

- `shapes`
- `routes.1+`
- `font.family (custom fonts)`
- `area (GeoJSON)`
- `pois.*.marker.icon (long data URIs work but POST is recommended)`

## Limits

| JSON field | GET parameter | Limit | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `width` | `w` | 64–2048 | `600` |
| `height` | `h` | 64–2048 | `400` |
| `scale` | `scale` | 1–3 | `1` |
| `quality` | `quality` | 1–100 | `90` |
| `padding` | `padding` | 0–0.45 | `0.04` |
| `pois` | `poi` | at most 50 items | `[]` |
| `pois[].label` | `label:` in `poi` | at most 160 characters | — |
| `routes` | one route in GET | at most 10 items | `[]` |
| `routes[].via` | `via` | at most 20 items | `[]` |
| `shapes` | POST only | at most 50 items | `[]` |
| `title.text` | `title` | at most 200 characters | — |
| `neighbors.max` | POST only | 1–30 | `12` |

## Basemap presets

Built-in basemap: shaded relief (Wikipedia locator style), light, or dark. No key needed. Values: `locator-relief`, `light`, `dark`.

## Marker presets

Marker preset. Defaults depend on the role: plain point → `pin`, route start → `ring`, route finish → `flag`. Values: `pin`, `dot`, `ring`, `flag`, `triangle`, `circle`, `square`, `star`, `diamond`.
